name: round 2: cross
tests: a child's genome is the same in two runs, and the same whichever order its parents are written in
cross(a, b, clutch) in src/cross.mjs is pure and symmetric, and returns the command's child
lineages have one written form: case, spaces, ×, #1 and the parents' order do not change the child
every child has round 1's fields inside the rules' ranges, plus its parents, its clutch and its mutations
over 11,300 children: species, affinity and every trait come from a parent, or are listed as mutations
over 10,000 children: about one trait in 50 mutates, and about one child of two common parents in 64 is rare
children take after both parents: traits from each side, colors near their parents', and siblings that differ
lineages of 6 generations and 120 characters hatch, and so does a word crossed with itself
a bad lineage exits 2 with a reason on stderr and nothing on stdout
plain seeds keep their creature: the round 1 winner's 466 recorded genomes are unchanged
?seed= opens a child, exactly the genome the command prints, and its family tree names its parents and grandparents
typing a cross and pressing Enter hatches the child, and the address it writes opens that child again
a bad lineage typed in the page shows a reason and keeps the creature
the card shows a child's name, species, affinity, stats and the words of its lineage
Save GIF downloads a child's animated GIF
Save card downloads a child's PNG card
